title: A Archive for the Colony
author: Ines Voss
blurb: Hazel Yarrow, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, has spent ten years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
